metadata.description: An explicit edge to firebase-server:build-base, NOT `^build`. This entry point cannot compile before the parent's dist exists, so the edge is real -- but it has to be spelled out, because `^build` here would resolve to firebase-server:build, which depends on this very target: a hard cycle. That XOR is the whole design constraint -- either the children get `^build` or the parent aggregates them, never both. Aggregating is the side that keeps one writer per dist directory.  This entry point also imports @dereekb/firebase-server/oidc, a SIBLING entry point in this same family, so it carries an in-family edge to `firebase-server-oidc:build-base`. A sibling edge is spelled as `build-base` (not `build`): siblings compile into this same dist directory and have no `build` of their own, and the parent's `build` is what depends on all of them, so pointing at it here would close the cycle the parent-edge comment describes.
